title: 2026 BMW 3-Series
pros: Well-tuned engines | athletic handling | upscale cabin with easy-to-use tech.
cons: We crave more steering feedback and a manual transmission | some options should really be standard.
verdict: The 2026 BMW 3-series leads the sports sedan class by being good at pretty much everything.

title: 2026 Porsche 911
pros: Benchmark-setting handling and speed | models to suit almost any need | even the base Carrera is stupendous.
cons: Ever-climbing price tags | digital dash eliminates analog charm | Carrera T is the only remaining 911 with a manual transmission.
verdict: The 2026 Porsche 911 has steadily evolved—its engine choices even include a hybrid powertrain—but it’s still the sports car benchmark that it’s always been.

title: 2026 Toyota Tacoma Hybrid
pros: Seamless hybrid implementation | responsive steering | an off-road aficionado's dream.
cons: Slower than the nonhybrid Taco | only marginal fuel economy gains | top models feel more full- than mid-size.
verdict: The Toyota Tacoma Hybrid has all the hallmark Taco traits, but its hybrid system doesn't offer significant enough benefits to justify its lofty price.

title: 2026 GMC Sierra 1500
pros: Choice of three solid powertrains | good towing and payload ratings | crew cab has a massive interior.
cons: Lower trims push limits of GMC's upscale image | Super Cruise limited to Denali | lacks the Ram's polished ride.
verdict: The 2026 GMC Sierra works just as hard as its Chevy Silverado sibling but adds a layer of refinement and luxury on top.

title: 2026 Ford Ranger
pros: Brawny engine options | quiet cabin and smooth ride | handsome from every angle.
cons: Steering needs work | vertical infotainment screen draws eyes down | useful driver aids cost extra.
verdict: The 2026 Ford Ranger mid-size pickup delivers competitive towing and payload figures, but doesn't sacrifice a complaint ride and decent road manners in the process.

title: 2026 Chevrolet Colorado
pros: Rival-besting engine output and tow ratings | cleanly styled and comfortable inside | highly capable off-road models.
cons: Only one cab-and-bed configuration | ZR2 has the same engine as lesser trims | we optimistically await a diesel.
verdict: The 2026 Chevrolet Colorado mid-size pickup truck is a more manageable Silverado.

title: 2026 Honda Prelude
pros: Sports-car handling | hybrid fuel economy | hatchback practicality.
cons: Unimpressive acceleration | no manual transmission | more expensive than the Civic it’s based on.
verdict: The revived Prelude doesn't quite live up to the promise of its nameplate due to its lack of a manual transmission, it has an enticing combination of hybrid power, sporty handling, and hatchback practicality.

title: 2026 Honda Pilot
pros: Agreeable ride quality | plenty of space for people and things | TrailSport model can handle mild-to-moderate off-roading.
cons: Top trims' interiors aren’t as upscale as rivals | anonymous exterior design | lacks unique attributes | features | or capabilities that would set it apart.
verdict: The Honda Pilot is a capable family hauler with some extra off-road capability, but it lacks a standout trait to elevate it above the mid-size 3-row mid-pack.

title: 2026 Honda Ridgeline
pros: Spacious cabin | comfy-as-a-minivan ride | cool in-bed storage compartment.
cons: Limited to one crew-cab body style | rivals tow more | could use a desert-ripping performance variant.
verdict: The 2026 Honda Ridgeline is a good choice for those who regularly need a pickup bed but more often, a daily driver.

title: 2026 Honda HR-V
pros: Spacious interior | well-tuned suspension | few compromises with the base trim.
cons: Leisurely acceleration | gritty powertrain | no hybrid or extra-power option.
verdict: The 2026 Honda HR-V is a nicely packaged small SUV in search of a more refined and powerful powertrain.

title: 2026 Honda Prologue
pros: Decent driving range estimates | fairly quick charging times | spacious cabin.
cons: Uncharacteristically bland to drive for a Honda | acceleration isn't as satisfying as higher-powered EVs | too many GM parts are visible.
verdict: Honda created the Prologue starting with GM's mid-size EV SUV platform, but brand aficionados may find the resulting product a little too unfamiliar.

title: 2026 Honda CR-V Fuel Cell
pros: Battery adds flexibility when you're not near a hydrogen station | drives like a normal CR-V | appreciable range.
cons: Hydrogen stations are not getting easier to find | reduced cargo room | leisurely acceleration.
verdict: Honda is re-entering the hydrogen-powered EV segment with a new fuel-cell crossover based on the popular CR-V SUV.

title: 2026 Honda Odyssey
pros: Quick and nimble | packed with features | flexible seating arrangements.
cons: All-wheel drive is unavailable | Magic Slide seats don’t stow under the floor | subpar fuel economy.
verdict: The 2026 Honda Odyssey is a minivan for those who value space, clever seating solutions, and good driving dynamics.

title: 2026 Ford F-150 Raptor
pros: Massively capable off-road | two tenacious engines | docile on the pavement.
cons: Mortgage-like monthly gas bill | V-8 moves the price up a tax bracket | makes normal parking spots feel miniature.
verdict: With long-travel suspension, chunky all-terrain tires, and up to 720 horsepower, the Ford F-150 Raptor is an off-road beast and surprisingly civil on road.

title: 2026 Ram HD
pros: Stylish interior | compliant ride for an HD truck | revised inline-six diesel is the best iteration yet.
cons: Price nearly as big as its wheelbase | swills fuel of either type | competitors can tow slightly more.
verdict: The 2026 Ram HD pickup truck is a genuine roughneck at heart but isn’t afraid to pamper its occupants with modern cabin and plenty of tech.

title: 2026 Hyundai Santa Cruz
pros: Carlike ride and handling | user-friendly infotainment | upscale interior design.
cons: Four-foot cargo bed has its limits | big upcharge for the turbo engine | limited off-road capability.
verdict: The 2026 Hyundai Santa Cruz is a compact pickup that's designed for user-friendly utility rather than image-making pretense.

title: 2026 Ford Ranger Raptor
pros: Beastly twin-turbo V-6 | easily maneuverable on tight trails | a force of nature on any surface.
cons: All-terrain tires offer limited cornering grip | Colorado ZR2 costs less | can't tow like the standard Ranger.
verdict: Like its prehistoric namesake, the Ford Ranger Raptor is agile and ruthlessly carnivorous, brandishing a 405-hp V-6 and a body fit for tight trails.

title: 2026 Nissan Frontier
pros: Solid overall value | offers more bed and cab configurability than rivals | old-school knobs and buttons are easy to use.
cons: Interior not as polished as competitors | only adequate towing capabilities | crew cab is a bit cramped.
verdict: The Nissan Frontier fulfills its mission as an affordable mid-size pickup that is highly configurable and capable, though it lacks some interior polish.

title: 2026 Rivian R1T
pros: Tri- and Quad-Motor's face-melting performance | unique gear tunnel is genuinely useful | impeccable ride quality.
cons: Inaccessible pricing for the blue-collar masses | lacks Apple CarPlay and Android Auto support | off-road tires severely impact range.
verdict: The electric pickup ranks are growing, but the Rivian R1T remains our favorite thanks to its clever packaging, big-truck utility, and stellar performance.

title: 2026 Ford Super Duty Review, ﻿Pricing, and Specs
pros: Impressive towing capabilities | massive trim variety | surprisingly fuel efficient.
cons: Hopeless automatic trailer backup assist | Ram HD feels fancier | top trims come with debt-swelling price tags.
verdict: Heavy hauling is the Ford Super Duty's forte, but top trims can get mighty luxurious when fully optioned.

title: 2026 Chevrolet Silverado EV
pros: Massive range | lightning-fast (ahem) charging | new Trail Boss trim expands lineup.
cons: Base trims are a little spartan for the price | no Apple CarPlay with the premium infotainment system | vague brake pedal and unimpressive stopping performance.
verdict: With up to 492 miles of range and competitive payload and towing numbers, the 2026 Chevrolet Silverado EV pickup asks few concessions for going electric.

title: 2026 GMC Hummer EV Pickup
pros: Utterly shocking acceleration | plenty of electric range | pillowy ride.
cons: Lackluster interior | lofty starting price | could use better brakes.
verdict: With a 9640-pound curb weight and up to 1000 horsepower, the GMC Hummer EV Pickup is a gargantuan electric truck wielding equally massive figures.

title: 2026 Ford F-150
pros: An engine type for every need | competitive towing and payload capacities | near countless cab | bed | and trim combos.
cons: Stiff-riding rear suspension | mainstream trims' down-market cabin materials.
verdict: Ford’s F-150 pickup comes in enough permutations to handle just about any vehicular assignment, from job sites to off-road trails to just cruising around.

title: Want a Truck Without the Bulk? The 2026 Ford Maverick Nails It
pros: Practical for its size | fuel-saving hybrid powertrain option | easy to park and drive in tight urban settings.
cons: Firm ride may not suit all drivers | entry-level model is too spartan | the Hyundai Santa Cruz can tow heavier trailers.
verdict: Not everyone needs an F-150, and that's where the 2026 Ford Maverick comes in, with its small stature, fuel-efficient powertrains, and practical design.

title: 2026 Toyota Tacoma
pros: Wide range of trims and configurations | available rear coil springs improve ride | the only pickup still offered with a manual transmission.
cons: Trail-friendly trims are expensive | can't tow as much as competitors | choosing a higher trim forces you into the hybrid model.
verdict: The 2026 Toyota Tacoma pickup offers a body style and trim to fit any need, each packed with competitive features and capability.

title: 2026 Chevrolet Silverado HD
pros: Good performance considering its heft | spacious and comfortable cabin | helpful towing tech.
cons: Ford and Ram offer more towing and payload capability | the interior lacks the upscale trappings that Ram does so well | high prow obscures lower forward visibility.
verdict: The 2026 Chevrolet Silverado HD pickup is a vehicular packhorse, designed to tow and haul heavy loads without breaking a sweat.

title: 2026 Tesla Cybertruck
pros: Ridiculously quick | drives smaller than it is | being part of the Cybertruck club.
cons: Tesla's broken promises | stainless steel isn't actually stain-proof | getting the side-eye from passersby.
verdict: The polygonal 2026 Tesla Cybertruck electric pickup is quick, dramatic, and controversial.

title: 2026 Ram 1500
pros: Smooth ride for a pickup truck | optional twin-turbo inline-six brings the muscle | premium cabin in top models.
cons: Towing capacity is lower than key rivals | aloof steering | nicest versions come with eye-popping price tags.
verdict: From the base Tradesman trim to the dressed-up Tungsten, there's a 2026 Ram 1500 pickup for every job.

title: 2026 McLaren 750S
pros: Blistering | otherworldly acceleration | advanced aerodynamics | amazingly comfortable ride.
cons: Short on cargo space | Android Auto not available | and of course | it costs a bundle.
verdict: The 2026 McLaren 750S coupe and Spider bring the racecar experience to the street but remain perfectly livable when you're not in a hurry.

title: 2026 Toyota GR Supra
pros: Overachieving BMW turbo-six engine | available with a shift-it-yourself transmission | an excellent excitement-to-cost ratio.
cons: Tight interior | massive blind spots | Android Auto not available.
verdict: The Toyota GR Supra coupe delivers traditional big-time sports car performance and driving enjoyment at a reasonable price.

title: 2026 BMW Z4
pros: Two lively powertrains | deluxe interior | quick-operating softtop.
cons: Handling isn’t as focused as other sports cars | rear-wheel drive only | getting the manual transmission costs more.
verdict: The 2026 BMW Z4 offers a blend of comfort and sportiness that translates to fun weekend rips and painless weekday commutes.

title: 2026 Chevrolet Corvette ZR1 / ZR1X
pros: Wildly quick straight-line acceleration | amazing performance value | impressive aerodynamics help track performance.
cons: Not enough of a step up from the Z06 in terms of handling and braking | interior isn't upgraded enough over standard model.
verdict: With up to 1250 horsepower, advanced aerodynamics, and a superhero chassis, the 2026 Chevrolet Corvette ZR1 lays down the gauntlet to the established supercar class.

title: 2026 BMW M2
pros: Sweet inline-six engine | delightful manual transmission still available | new CS model ramps up the intensity.
cons: Back seats in name only | diminutive trunk | front- and rear-end designs still a bit polarizing.
verdict: With compact dimensions, big power, and an available manual transmission, the M2 delivers visceral enthusiast thrills in a modern package.

title: 2026 Toyota GR86
pros: Sweetly tuned sports car handling | gobs of steering feedback | rev-happy four-cylinder has enough power to make driving fun.
cons: Excessive highway road noise | rear seats only large enough for inanimate objects.
verdict: With sharp steering, an impeccably tuned chassis, and a starting price just above 30 grand, the Toyota GR86 is a brilliant sports car for the masses.

title: 2026 Chevrolet Corvette Z06
pros: The 8500-rpm V-8 located amidship | race-car-like handling | unbelievable value proposition.
cons: No row-your-own gearbox | guzzles gas by the tankerful | European performance without as much prestige.
verdict: With its extraordinary performance, exotic-car looks and personality, and hard-to-believe value, the mid-engine Z06 brings the fight to the European sports car establishment.

title: 2026 Chevrolet Corvette Stingray
pros: Exotic-car styling | unbeatable performance value | upper trims are luxury-car nice inside.
cons: No manual transmission option | no rear seat | Chevy badge offers less cachet than BMW or Porsche competitors.
verdict: If you're looking for maximum performance at a good price, the 2026 Corvette Stingray is the best choice for going fast and saving money.

title: 2026 Ferrari 12Cilindri / 12Cilindri Spider
pros: Futuristic looks with nods to the past | speed builds effortlessly | a pitch-perfect V-12 soundtrack.
cons: Annoying touch-based interface | hard to see out the back | seats could use more padding.
verdict: The 2026 Ferrari 12Cilindri eschews electrification, instead marrying an old-school V-12 with Ferrari's latest chassis tech in either coupe or convertible form.

title: 2026 Ferrari F80
pros: Insane levels of performance | absolutely wild styling | surprisingly accessible driving experience.
cons: Out of reach price tag | all units are already spoken for | rearview camera is the only way to see behind you.
verdict: A new performance flagship for Ferrari is here, and it channels past icons such as the F40 and LaFerrari but adds modern touches including a hybrid powertrain.

title: 2026 Mazda MX-5 Miata
pros: A joy to drive | accessible pricing | open-top freedom comes standard.
cons: Bereft of cabin cubbies | puny trunk | gets noisy at highway speeds.
verdict: The iconic MX-5 Miata combines a lightweight sports car body, sharp handling, and a rev-happy four-cylinder to maximize driving fun at an accessible price.

title: 2026 Volkswagen Golf R
pros: Stealthy looks | tons of power | an advanced all-wheel-drive system to put it to the ground.
cons: We're still mourning the loss of the manual transmission | costs a lot more than a GTI | irksome touch-sensitive steering-wheel controls are still here.
verdict: The 2026 Volkswagen Golf R hatchback is a strong track performer, but its added gusto compared to the GTI may not make sense for all buyers.

title: 2026 Chevrolet Corvette E-Ray
pros: All-wheel-drive traction helps both acceleration and handling | easygoing ride for when you just want to cruise | two trunks add practicality.
cons: Fuel economy isn't any better than the nonhybrid Stingray | electric-only range is very limited | not as much of a flex as a Porsche or a McLaren.
verdict: Even though it has a hybrid powertrain, the 2026 Chevrolet Corvette E-Ray won't save you much at the pump. But it will outperform some of the world's best sports cars.

title: 2026 Porsche 911 Turbo S
pros: Fabulously quick acceleration | near-ideal ride and handling balance | more practical than its supercar rivals.
cons: Looks may be too subdued for some | spine-shattering Sport suspension | high sticker price for a 911.
verdict: The 2026 Porsche 911 Turbo S continues to elevate performance without diluting the core essence of the 911 blueprint.

title: 2026 Subaru BRZ
pros: A blast on twisty roads | more practical than a Miata | still reasonably priced.
cons: Noisy cabin at highway speeds | lackluster exhaust tone | a rear seat made for luggage rather than bottoms.
verdict: The BRZ keeps the affordable in "affordable sports car," with a still-reasonable price, a manual transmission, a dialed-in chassis, and very little else.

title: 2026 BMW i4
pros: Playful handling | smart looks | effortlessly quick acceleration.
cons: Middling range estimates | cramped back seat | light on steering feel.
verdict: The BMW i4 Gran Coupe gains a little extra efficiency for 2026.

title: 2026 Tesla Model 3
pros: Satisfyingly quick acceleration | quiet and comfortable cabin | priced attractively for its performance quotient.
cons: Real-world range falls short of estimates | relies too heavily on touchscreen for basic functions | Apple CarPlay and Android Auto are MIA.
verdict: The aging Tesla Model 3 practically invented the EV sedan segment, but a steady stream of updates help keep it competitive.

title: 2026 BMW 4-Series Gran Coupe
pros: Punchy turbo engines | sporty handling | up-to-date interior tech features.
cons: Sloping roofline impedes rear-seat headroom | more steering feel would be nice | interior isn't as flashy as the exterior.
verdict: For BMW buyers wanting a little more style in their compact sports sedan, the 2026 4-series Gran Coupe delivers athletic handling with a side of rakish good looks.

title: 2026 Toyota Prius PHEV
pros: Rakish profile subverts dorky hybrid stereotype | engaging to drive | well-equipped at all trim levels.
cons: Headroom is tight | interior materials feel a bit cut-rate | instrument cluster has a learning curve.
verdict: The 2026 Toyota Prius PHEV is an efficiency superstar, delivering up to 50 MPG in hybrid mode or 127 MPGe on battery power alone.

title: 2026 Honda Civic Si
pros: Impeccable six-speed manual | bargain price | accessible performance.
cons: Could use a few more ponies | underwhelming exhaust tone | the Civic Type R exists.
verdict: Other sport compacts pack more punch but few can match the Honda Civic Si's blend of performance, practicality, and affordability.

title: 2026 Volkswagen Golf GTI
pros: Turbo engine has plenty of get-up-and-go | comfortable and capable chassis | hatchback practicality.
cons: Lacks some interior polish | steering feedback could be better | no more manual transmission.
verdict: Even without a manual transmission, the Golf GTI is a blast to drive and lives up to its reputation as the quintessential hot hatchback.

title: 2026 Cadillac CT5-V Blackwing
pros: Standard six-speed manual transmission | available Precision package track hones an already sharp scalpel | monster supercharged V-8 power.
cons: Interior lacks upscale vibe | some driver-assists not available on the manual | this year could be its last.
verdict: A perennial C/D favorite, the 2026 Cadillac CT5-V Blackwing blends track-annihilating skills with sedan practicality in a way few others can.

title: 2026 Porsche Taycan Cross Turismo
pros: Blistering acceleration | superb handling | a station wagon in an ocean of SUVs.
cons: Taycan sedan starts thousands less and gives up little | a few more primary hard controls would be welcome.
verdict: Packing plenty of power and room for five and their stuff, the 2026 Porsche Taycan Cross Turismo is a superhero EV that just happens to be a wagon.

title: 2026 Mercedes-Benz CLA-Class EV
pros: Impressive driving range | agile and nimble feel in corners | comfortable ride.
cons: Array of screens inside can be overwhelming | small rear seat | some cheap interior materials.
verdict: Mercedes-Benz's entry-level model enters its third generation with two electric variants—the single-motor CLA250+ and the dual-motor CLA350.

title: 2026 Rolls-Royce Phantom
pros: Unmistakable curbside presence | immaculately outfitted cabin | truly bespoke builds are possible if you have a blank check.
cons: Guzzles gas like a full-size pickup truck | best experienced as a passenger | jaw-dropping starting price.
verdict: The Phantom is Rolls-Royce's ultimate expression of its super-luxury ethos, and it wears a half-million-dollar price tag that matches its legendary status.

title: 2026 Hyundai Sonata
pros: Stylish inside and out | loaded with driver aids | appreciably quick in N Line guise.
cons: Unremarkable handling | middling second-row space | the Honda Accord still exists.
verdict: The 2026 Hyundai Sonata is affordable, soft-riding, and feature-heavy—just what people want out of a mid-size family sedan.

title: 2026 BMW M4
pros: Seductive and explosive turbocharged inline-six | chassis built for speed | cozy yet fashionable interior.
cons: No manual for the Competition model | lack of steering feel | convoluted drive modes.
verdict: If you love the upscale hustle of the legendary M3 sedan but prefer a two-door aesthetic, the 2026 BMW M4 coupe is here to save the day.

title: 2026 Hyundai Elantra
pros: Available with a smooth and efficient hybrid | N Line handles well | long features list.
cons: Spiritless nonturbo models | real-world fuel economy falls short of estimates | smaller screen has better smartphone tech.
verdict: The 2026 Hyundai Elantra is an edgy-looking, well-equipped, reasonably priced option in the compact sedan class.

title: 2026 Genesis G70
pros: Svelte styling | stout power from both engine options | excellent value proposition.
cons: Limited rear-seat legroom | no more sporty adaptive suspension | unimpressive fuel economy.
verdict: The Genesis G70 has the poise and premium accommodations to challenge costlier luxury sport sedans from more established European marques.

title: 2026 Toyota Prius
pros: Turns heads (in a good way) | fun to drive quickly | still the go-to choice for hypermilers.
cons: Limited headroom in back | poor gauge placement | makes droning sounds when pushed.
verdict: The 2026 Toyota Prius hatchback is out to save the planet and look good while doing it.

title: 2026 Porsche Taycan
pros: Impeccable handling | impressive DC charge speed | vision-altering acceleration.
cons: Less range than other high-horsepower rivals | tight on cargo space | price tags that keep spiraling upward.
verdict: The Taycan provides one of the best driving experiences in the electric sedan segment — what else would you expect from Porsche?

title: 2026 BMW M3
pros: Stellar inline-six engine | confidence-inspiring handling | effortless switch between track toy and daily commuter.
cons: Drive mode overload | top-dog AWD model only comes with an automatic | controversial maw.
verdict: Blending cardiac-straining performance with daily livability, the 2026 BMW M3 lives up to the nameplate's legendary status.

title: 2026 Genesis G80
pros: Plenty of curbside presence | elegant interior environs | well-designed tech interface.
cons: Performance could be better | Sport models' less-than-polished ride | not the bargain it used to be.
verdict: For 2026, the Genesis G80 continues as a well-rounded mid-size luxury sedan and one of our favorites in the segment.

title: 2026 Honda Civic
pros: Attractive inside and out | efficient | quick in hybrid form.
cons: Underpowered with base engine | all-wheel drive isn't an option | large interior displays are exclusive to the top trim.
verdict: Available in sedan or hatchback form, with or without a hybrid powertrain, the 2026 Honda Civic caters to just about everyone.

title: 2026 Kia K4
pros: Attractively modern styling | adult-friendly back seat | high-value standard features list.
cons: Ho-hum handling | base engine lacks oomph.
verdict: The 2026 Kia K4 isn’t as sporty its aggressive styling suggests but it is a satisfying choice thanks to its affordability, good looks, and roominess.

title: 2026 Cadillac CT4-V Blackwing
pros: Communicative steering | instinctual powertrain responses | adaptive dampers provide great ride and handling balance.
cons: Tight on rear passenger room | larger and more potent CT5-V Blackwing sibling hard to deny | interior bits look a little downmarket.
verdict: With a honed chassis, a potent twin-turbo V-6, and an available manual transmission, the 2026 Cadillac CT4-V Blackwing remains a sports-sedan high mark for the modern age.

title: 2026 Honda Civic Type R
pros: Race-car driving excitement | six-speed snicks through gears | versatile hatchback body style.
cons: Firm ride | rear bench only seats two | can't get heated seats.
verdict: The 2026 Honda Civic Type R combines the versatility of the Civic hatchback with sports-car performance. Commence grocery runs and track-day adventures alike.

title: 2026 Toyota Camry
pros: Smooth hybrid powertrain | attractive and roomy interior | formidable fuel economy.
cons: Vague steering | lacks athleticism | more expensive than its staunchest rivals.
verdict: The Toyota Camry has the family-sedan bases covered, offering solid efficiency, a spacious interior, and adequate performance at an attainable price.

title: 2026 Nissan Sentra
pros: Attractive exterior styling | upscale interior digs | composed ride and handling.
cons: Underpowered engine | no hybrid powertrain option as in rivals | unexciting to drive.
verdict: The 2026 Nisan Sentra returns with fresh styling inside and out but carries on with the previous model's ho-hum four-cylinder and CVT powertrain under hood.

title: 2026 Mercedes-Benz E-Class
pros: Oozes luxury inside | tons of standard and available tech | silken inline-six engine.
cons: Tightish trunk | annoying touch controls | extras cost a lot extra.
verdict: The 2026 Mercedes-Benz E-class sedan is a rare blend of elegance, luxury, comfort, tech, and driving enjoyment.

title: 2026 Porsche Panamera Turbo E-Hybrid / Turbo S E-Hybrid
pros: Autobahn-storming speed | sports car-like handling | subtle hatchback design hides a big trunk.
cons: Six-figure starting price | so many digital displays | this is one hybrid that isn’t focused on fuel economy.
verdict: Few sedans can master the opposing tasks of luxury cruising and high-performance driving as well as the 2026 Porsche Panamera Turbo E-Hybrid.

title: 2026 BMW 7-Series
pros: Smooth and seamless power from all three powertrains | light on its feet for a big brute | thoroughly insulated cabin.
cons: Tech might be overwhelming for less savvy buyers | lifeless steering | rear-seat passengers have all the fun.
verdict: The 2026 BMW 7-series is comfortable, quick, and serene, with a tranquil cabin and three peppy powertrains that move the lavish cruise ship with ease.

title: 2026 Kia K5
pros: Striking looks | 290-hp GT model is a riot to drive | plenty of standard equipment.
cons: Driver's seat sits higher than we'd like | GT is held back by its all-season rubber | opting for big wheels harshes the ride.
verdict: The 2026 Kia K5 family sedan stands out from staid-looking segment competitors while delivering good value and a bit of fun.

title: 2026 Cadillac CT4 Review, Pricing and Specs
pros: Peppy off the line | upscale looks at an entry-level price | one of the only rear-wheel drive options in its segment.
cons: Mushy around corners | sub-premium interior materials | cramped rear seats.
verdict: As Cadillac's least-expensive offering, the CT4 attempts to distill Caddy’s premium ethos into a compact luxury sedan with mixed results.

title: 2026 Subaru Crosstrek Hybrid
pros: Standard mechanical AWD system | rugged-looking exterior design | feels like a Subaru.
cons: MPG isn't competitive with other hybrid SUVs | noisy engine | significantly pricier than the nonhybrid.
verdict: New to the Subaru lineup for 2026 is the Crosstrek Hybrid, which adds an eco-friendly element to the SUV's adventure-ready vibe.

title: 2026 Chevrolet Suburban
pros: Payload-hauling hero | optional diesel adds fuel efficiency | surprising athleticism for its size.
cons: Luxurious upper trims are pricey | gas V-8s aren't great on fuel | entry-level model is too spartan.
verdict: If towing is on the task list, but you also need to haul up to nine people and their cargo simultaneously, the 2026 Chevy Suburban is the SUV best suited to the job.

title: 2026 Lucid Gravity
pros: Quick acceleration | long driving-range estimates | megasize cargo room.
cons: High-tier trims come with massive price tags | third-row seats not standard.
verdict: For Lucid's second act, the EV startup has rolled out the 2026 Gravity SUV, with an upscale cabin and a maximum estimated range of 450 miles per charge.

title: 2026 Hyundai Tucson Hybrid
pros: Choice of hybrid and plug-in-hybrid powertrains | handily outdoes the gas-only Tucson's fuel economy | better acceleration than the nonhybrid.
cons: PHEV's electric driving range is just so-so | plug-in battery reduces cargo room | competitor hybrids are more efficient.
verdict: The 2026 Hyundai Tucson Hybrid SUV doesn't cost much more than its nonhybrid sibling but offers better fuel efficiency and quicker acceleration.

title: 2026 Chevrolet Trax
pros: Rides and handles well | hushed cabin | cavernous cargo area.
cons: Lackluster acceleration | some scratchy interior plastics | no all-wheel drive.
verdict: The Chevrolet Trax is one of the least expensive new cars on the market, but its quality construction and pleasant driving experience are a step above its asking price.

title: 2026 Mercedes-Benz GLC350e Hybrid
pros: Class-leading electric range | richly decked-out cabin | plenty roomy inside.
cons: Awkward steering-wheel touch controls | weirdly inconsistent brake feel | hybrid system's occasional slow response to your right foot.
verdict: The 2026 Mercedes-Benz GLC-Class Hybrid SUV is a plug-in that can go an impressive 54 miles on electricity alone, but it's not as impressive when the charge runs out.

title: 2026 Volvo EX30
pros: Simple and stylish interior design | genuinely quick Twin Motor electric powertrain available | attractive price point.
cons: Minimal rear-seat legroom | no dedicated head-up or gauge display | budget-friendly single motor model isn't as quick.
verdict: The Volvo EX30 is an amusing and simple subcompact EV SUV, giving you everything you need and nothing you don’t.

title: 2026 Hyundai Ioniq 9
pros: Library-quiet interior | plenty of space for people and their stuff | modern styling.
cons: Some interior materials slightly of tune | hefty price premium over Palisade sibling | video-game illumination elements may overwhelm some buyers.
verdict: Hyundai joins the mid-size EV SUV space with the fully modern three-row 2026 Ioniq 9.

title: 2026 BMW iX
pros: Tranquil cruising | competitive driving range | deluxe cabin.
cons: Busy exterior styling is polarizing | low rear seating position.
verdict: Futuristic, flashy, and fancy, the 2026 BMW iX SUV drives well, coddles its passengers, and goes far on a charge.

title: 2026 BMW X5
pros: Smooth-running engine options | plush cabin | plenty of modern tech features.
cons: Athleticism takes a back seat in this BMW | upgrading to the V-8 requires a hefty outlay of cash | no third-row option.
verdict: It doesn’t handle as nimbly as a 3-series sedan, but the 2026 BMW X5 offers luxury, refinement, and practicality in equal doses.

title: Nissan Reinvented the Leaf for 2026: The Glow-up Is Real
pros: Improved driving range | quiet and comfortable ride | upscale interior design.
cons: Acceleration is merely adequate | doesn't offer all-wheel drive | unexciting handling.
verdict: For the 2026 model year, the Nissan Leaf EV is reimagined as a small SUV with more modern styling, better range, and a nicer interior.

title: 2026 Chevrolet Tahoe
pros: More agile than expected for a full-size SUV | fuel-efficient diesel option | spacious cabin.
cons: Top trims command a big spend | gas-fed V-8s guzzle fuel | limited cargo space with the third row of seats in use.
verdict: The 2026 Chevy Tahoe is as refined on the road as it is capable off-road, and its variety of use cases makes it an attractive option among full-size SUVs.

title: 2026 Mercedes-Benz GLC-Class / GLC-Class Coupe
pros: Silky turbo four-cylinder | finely crafted interior | comfortable and controlled road manners.
cons: Lifeless steering | pricey options might cause sticker shock | vexing touchpad steering-wheel controls.
verdict: Smooth, upscale, and composed, the Mercedes GLC-class earns its spot as one of the frontrunners in the entry-luxe SUV segment.

title: 2026 Volvo XC40
pros: Clean design | packed with features | upscale and spacious inside.
cons: Irksome infotainment system with few hard buttons | unimpressive fuel economy.
verdict: The 2026 Volvo XC40 is a strong contender among subcompact luxury SUVs thanks to its youthful, clean design and generous feature set.

title: 2026 BMW X1
pros: Sharp handling | impressive standard feature content | spacious for a subcompact SUV.
cons: Occasional turbo lag can spoil the mood | M35i rides too harshly | drivers may lament the lack of infotainment buttons.
verdict: The 2026 BMW X1 is an excellent subcompact SUV for anyone who values driving as much as they do a tech-forward, luxurious interior.

title: 2026 Hyundai Palisade Hybrid
pros: Responsive acceleration | improved fuel economy over the nonhybrid | posh styling inside and out.
cons: Real-world highway fuel economy disappoints | third-row seat isn't the most spacious | handling could be sharper.
verdict: The mid-size 2026 Hyundai Palisade SUV Hybrid makes its debut sharing the same all-new boxy styling and premium feature updates as the nonhybrid model.

title: 2026 Hyundai Palisade
pros: Appealing exterior design | premium cabin | plenty of convenient features come standard.
cons: Snug third row | merely adequate acceleration performance | muted driving demeanor.
verdict: The mid-size Hyundai Palisade SUV is redesigned for the 2026 model year, and its new look is more premium and more boxy.

title: 2026 Hyundai Ioniq 5
pros: Rapid charging speeds | distinctive styling | engaging and cheery driving personality.
cons: Speediest version gives up range | steering a little light on feel | frunk is an afterthought.
verdict: With decent range, fast charging, and a spacious interior, the 2026 Hyundai Ioniq 5 EV is a versatile tool for navigating modern life.

title: 2026 Lexus UX
pros: Exceptional fuel efficiency | available all-wheel drive | full complement of standard safety tech.
cons: Tight rear seat | pokey acceleration | limited cargo capacity.
verdict: The 2026 Lexus UX300h delivers efficiency first and luxury second.

title: 2026 GMC Yukon
pros: Towing-friendly diesel option | posh and spacious cabin | tons of desirable features on offer.
cons: More expensive than its Chevy cousins | V-8s guzzle gas | unwieldy to park.
verdict: With the power and capacity to move eight people, their gear, and a trailer with ease, the 2026 GMC Yukon SUV is a true utility vehicle.

title: 2026 Volvo XC60 Hybrid
pros: Powerful and parsimonious powertrain | mild styling tweaks freshen the exterior | good balance of practicality and luxury.
cons: Ride can be harsh on broken pavement | slow at recharging.
verdict: Read our 2026 Volvo XC60 Hybrid review for information on ratings, pricing, specs, and features, and see how this SUV performed in our testing.

title: 2026 Honda CR-V
pros: Agreeable ride | great rear-seat legroom | tech updates make its cabin more contemporary.
cons: Not as peppy or fuel efficient as the CR-V hybrid | continuously variable transmission is a letdown | AWD doesn't come standard.
verdict: The Honda CR-V is one of the most recognizable compact SUVs on the planet, and with an agreeable ride and a spacious interior, it's also one of the best.

title: 2026 Mazda CX-30
pros: Lithe and sporty chassis | class-above interior | standard features aplenty.
cons: Snug rear seats | tight cargo hold compared to other subcompact rivals | handling that begs you to pop for the turbocharged engine.
verdict: A near-luxury interior and plenty of behind-the-wheel verve set the Mazda CX-30 apart from its subcompact SUV rivals, but its small cabin hampers utility.

title: 2026 Kia Niro Hybrid
pros: The better of the two available hybrid subcompact SUVs | chic and well-equipped cabin | fuel-sipping powertrain.
cons: Sorely lacking athleticism | noisy on the highway | doesn't quite measure up to its EPA fuel economy estimates.
verdict: With a standard hybrid powertrain, the Kia Niro is a pocket-sized SUV that sips fuel but lacks hustle.

title: 2026 Lexus NX
pros: Compliant ride | upscale furnishings | impressive list of standard tech and safety features.
cons: A bit pokey for the segment | F-Sport deserves to be sportier.
verdict: The 2026 Lexus NX lacks the playful character of some subcompact SUV competitors, but its quiet, smooth ride and upscale interior delight.

title: 2026 Toyota RAV4
pros: Smooth and efficient hybrid powertrains | plug-in model packs a punch | lots of standard and optional features.
cons: Interior materials feel cheap | doesn't handle as well as some rivals | standard hybrid has a noisy engine.
verdict: Redesigned for 2026, the RAV4 Hybrid and RAV4 Plug-in Hybrid models are new, improved, and ready to take on our favorite compact SUVs.

title: The 2026 Subaru Trailseeker Looks More Like an Outback Than the Outback Does
pros: Comfy ride | spacious cabin with plenty of cargo room | perky acceleration.
cons: Several rivals offer more driving range | not particularly fun to drive | handy 360-degree camera only available on top two trims.
verdict: The Trailseeker joins Subaru's EV lineup, sporting some off-road capability and dressed in a mid-size SUV body with lifted station-wagon proportions.

title: 2026 Kia EV9
pros: All-wheel drive models feature quick acceleration | impressive DC fast-charging rate | spacious interior with useable third row.
cons: Single-motor base models lack range and power | overreliance on touch controls | hints of low-grade plastic inside.
verdict: Building on its proven three-row electric SUV, the EV9 ramps up the excitement for 2026 with a new high-performance GT model aiming to break 500 horsepower.

title: 2026 Toyota Grand Highlander Hybrid
pros: Smooth ride | adult-habitable third row | base powertrain gets great fuel economy.
cons: Lifeless steering | base hybrid isn't very quick | Hybrid Max can underperform its EPA highway mileage number.
verdict: The 2026 Toyota Grand Highlander Hybrid SUV is bigger inside than the standard Highlander and offers a satisfyingly strong powertrain not available on the shorter version.

title: 2026 Ford Bronco Sport
pros: More capable than most rivals when the pavement ends | off-road features available throughout the lineup | interior's practical touches.
cons: Three-cylinder engine is no powerhouse | borderline too-stiff ride | rear seat not particularly spacious.
verdict: While you can't remove its roof or doors—like you can with the big, bad Bronco—the 2026 Ford Bronco Sport can get further out into the boonies than many rivals.

title: 2026 BMW X2
pros: Fairly quick | comes well equipped | looks distinctive.
cons: Occasionally plagued by turbo lag | not quite as roomy as the X1 | steering response could be better.
verdict: The 2026 BMW X2 SUV is a stylish take on the already well-favored X1.

title: 2026 Porsche Cayenne Hybrid
pros: Ferocious plug-in hybrid powertrains | athletic handling | comfortable and well-crafted cabin.
cons: Eight-speed automatic lacks some finesse | dizzyingly expensive when fully loaded.
verdict: The 2026 Cayenne E-Hybrid is Porsche’s attempt at distilling nearly 80 years' worth of sports car pedigree into a plug-in-hybrid SUV — and it mostly works.

title: 2026 Mitsubishi Outlander Hybrid
pros: Generous EV range | class-leading warranty | Yamaha premium stereo system.
cons: Tiny third row | expensive for segment | mediocre fuel economy for a plug-in hybrid.
verdict: The 2026 Mitsubishi Outlander Hybrid is relatively competent and efficient but feels a little dated in the face of more modern competitors.

title: 2026 Tesla Model Y
pros: Long EPA driving-range estimates | strong acceleration | quieter interior than the previous model.
cons: Too many controls in the touchscreen | firm ride quality | awkward exterior design.
verdict: The Tesla Model Y receives a significant refresh for 2026, which keeps the popular electric SUV in the hunt among a growing segment of attractive options.

title: 2026 Mazda CX-50
pros: Playful handling | luxury-adjacent interior | available with a lively turbo four.
cons: A little snug | luxury-adjacent pricing | merely average warranty terms.
verdict: The 2026 Mazda CX-50 compact SUV has rugged good looks but refined manners.

title: 2026 BMW X5 Hybrid
pros: Up to 39 EPA-estimated EV-only miles of range | same premium luxury interior as the standard X5 | nearly as quick as the very quick gasoline-fed | twin-turbo V-8 powered X5 M60i.
cons: Price premium for going hybrid is steep | getting max fuel efficiency is dependent on a full battery.
verdict: The BMW X5 Hybrid brings all the luxury and sportiness of the regular X5 with a plug-in hybrid powertrain for increased fuel efficiency.

title: 2026 Volvo XC90 Hybrid
pros: Well-integrated hybrid powertrain | lovely cabin appointments | stately exterior.
cons: Slow-reacting infotainment system | no quick-charging option | ride is on the harsh side.
verdict: The 2026 Volvo XC90 T8 Hybrid SUV is still satisfying after many years thanks to important quality-of-life updates.

title: 2026 Toyota Grand Highlander
pros: Roomy and well-equipped interior | adult-friendly seating in every row | perfect for family road-tripping.
cons: Nondescript styling | engine growls harshly when accelerating hard | not much else.
verdict: SUV-me, please: The 2026 Toyota Grand Highlander three-row SUV is nearly as practical as a minivan and it's much less dorky.

title: 2026 Porsche Macan
pros: Unmistakably Porsche styling | more practical than a 911 | lithe chassis with dialed-in handling.
cons: Options pricing can get out of hand | infotainment system is due for an update | disappointing interior quality for the price.
verdict: Just as the 911 is a benchmark sports car, the Porsche Macan is a high-water mark for athletic compact crossovers that others look up to.

title: 2026 Toyota Corolla Cross Hybrid
pros: Fuel-efficient powertrain | peppy acceleration | value-oriented packaging.
cons: Could use some additional sound-deadening measures | cabin feels basic | forgettable road manners.
verdict: Decent, affordable transportation like the 2026 Toyota Corolla Cross Hybrid is becoming a rarity, but if you want more excitement you'll need to look elsewhere.

title: 2026 Genesis GV70
pros: Sharp looks inside and out | lots of features | strong engine choices.
cons: Not as performance-oriented as some competitors | limited rear-seat space | no hybrid option.
verdict: The GV70 achieves luxury-SUV superstardom thanks to athletic dynamics and a knockout design, and the 2026 model brings an enhanced interior and design tweaks.

title: 2026 Honda Passport
pros: Ruggedly attractive boxy new look | spacious interior | balances off-road capability with on-road refinement.
cons: Interior lacks pizzazz | more expensive than two-row rivals | middling fuel economy and no hybrid available.
verdict: The Honda Passport gets buff for 2026 with rugged styling and a significantly improved all-wheel-drive system.

title: 2026 Hyundai Ioniq 5 N
pros: Wicked acceleration | novel EV experience enhancements | entertaining handling.
cons: Spendy compared to the standard Ioniq 5 | too many powertrain and chassis settings | longer range would be nice.
verdict: The 2026 Hyundai Ioniq 5 N is as successful in pushing the envelope of EV performance as it is in mimicking the driving experience of an internal-combustion vehicle.

title: 2026 Mercedes-Benz GLB-Class
pros: Roomy for a small SUV | sharp-looking exterior | modern interior.
cons: Short on standard features | middling performance | going full-ritz with options is expensive.
verdict: The 2026 Mercedes-Benz GLB-class is a roomy subcompact SUV that delivers on the brand's promise of luxury.

title: 2026 Honda CR-V Hybrid
pros: Civilized and efficient hybrid powertrain | roomy interior | new larger standard infotainment touchscreen.
cons: Price premium over nonhybrid CR-V | could use a few more ponies.
verdict: The 2026 Honda CR-V Hybrid takes the inherent goodness of the CR-V compact SUV and adds a polished hybrid powertrain for increased efficiency and performance.

title: 2026 Ford Bronco Raptor
pros: High-flying off-road fun | comfortable on and off the pavement | has real road presence.
cons: Excessively thirsty | loud at speed | doesn’t come cheap.
verdict: The 2026 Ford Bronco Raptor SUV is a rock-crawling, dune-blasting brute that’s surprisingly tame in daily driving.

title: 2026 Ford Bronco
pros: Dunes | boulders | mountains—no problem | multitiude of off-road packages | every trim looks boss.
cons: Interior's hard plastic is tough to dress up | deserves a better exhaust note | wind noise on the highway will have you yelling.
verdict: The big, bad 2026 Ford Bronco loves to horse around in the dirt, but this go-anywhere Wrangler alternative earned our respect as much for its good on-road manners.

title: 2026 Ford Mustang
pros: Impressive performance | ferocious V-8 soundtrack | comfortable retro-modern interior.
cons: No manual four-cylinder | Dark Horse is awesome but expensive | puny rear seats seem unnecessary.
verdict: The legendary Ford Mustang doesn't let modern advancements get in the way of delivering a classic pony car experience.

title: 2026 Ford Explorer
pros: Comfy and ergonomically sound cabin | available with a full-bodied V-6 | praiseworthy tech.
cons: Claustrophobic third row | nothing special to drive | not as polished as many competitors.
verdict: The Ford Explorer has solid foundations as a fixture of the family mid-size SUV segment, but it lacks the ultimate polish of the leaders in its class.

title: 2026 Ford Escape Hybrid
pros: Appropriately fuel-efficient | roomy | intuitive infotainment system.
cons: Unremarkable handling | needs more pep | some awfully plain interior materials.
verdict: Guess what's next for the 2026 Ford Escape Hybrid, one of the pioneers of gas-electric SUVs.

title: 2026 Ford Expedition
pros: Twin-turbo V-6 has more power than some rival V-8s | class-leading towing capacity | impressive fuel economy for a colossus.
cons: Drives as big as it looks | some poorly placed controls | expensive when fully loaded.
verdict: The full-size Ford Expedition has the space, capability, and performance to make it a serious competitor in the realm of colossal family haulers.

title: 2026 Ford Mustang GTD
pros: Head-turning race-car looks | face-melting power | shockingly comfortable ride.
cons: Same as any ol' Mustang inside | no back seats or trunk | dearth of feedback through the steering wheel.
verdict: The 2026 Ford Mustang GTD brings the price, performance, and head-turning looks of an exotic to the Blue Oval's iconic two-door pony car.

title: 2026 Ford Mustang Mach-E
pros: Remarkably quick | class-competitive range | spacious | comfortable cabin.
cons: Spectacular rate of acceleration trails off after the 60-mph mark | lacks the visceral and aural elements of thundering V-8 Mustangs.
verdict: More EV than pony car, the 2026 Mustang Mach-E delivers competitive range and electrifying acceleration in a compact SUV configuration.

title: 2026 Ford Escape
pros: Appealing design | turbo-four's thrust | physical climate controls remain.
cons: Unsupportive seats | lazy handling | base trims' cut-rate interiors.
verdict: The 2026 Ford Escape is a zippy and handsome compact SUV, but its cut-rate interior holds it back.

title: 2026 Porsche Macan Electric
pros: Immaculate chassis balance | solid driving range | preserves the gas Macan's lively character.
cons: Huge price premium over the standard Macan | little interior flair over the gas model | outdated-looking infotainment system.
verdict: The Porsche Macan Electric nails the transition to green propulsion with impressive practicality and efficiency that doesn't sacrifice any driving pleasure.

title: 2026 Porsche 911 GT3
pros: Beastly acceleration | race car-like handling | the mesmerizing wail of its flat-six engine.
cons: Firm ride | eye-popping price tag | supercar pricing without the supercar looks.
verdict: With a screaming flat-six engine and racetrack handling, the 2026 Porsche 911 GT3 is an automotive icon with a competition pedigree and amazing performance.

title: 2026 Porsche Cayenne / Cayenne Coupe
pros: Sports-car-inspired handling | mega-powerful turbo V-8s | generous interior and cargo space.
cons: No third row of seats | Porsche charges extra for every little thing.
verdict: The Cayenne incorporates much of Porsche’s sporting ethos into its practical SUV body and tall ride height, making it a unique delight in its segment.

title: 2026 Porsche Panamera / Panamera E-Hybrid
pros: Locked to the pavement handling | impressively roomy | it’s always ready to play sports car.
cons: Not the quietest luxury sedan | it’s a Porsche | so pricing can get out of hand with options.
verdict: The 2026 Porsche Panamera sits on the fence between SUV and sedan bodystyles while also providing the driving experience of a sports car.

title: 2026 BMW X3
pros: Well-developed ride and handling balance | capable four- and six-cylinder powertrains boost acceleration and save fuel.
cons: Clunky styling elements front and rear | infotainment controls could be streamlined | faux engine-noise soundtrack can be annoying.
verdict: The 2026 BMW X3 compact SUV hits the sweet spot between performance and practicality, though its styling can be a bit controversial.

title: 2026 BMW 8-Series
pros: Both engines are stunners | classy cabin design | sublime ride quality.
cons: Hefty curb weight | rear seats are mostly unusable for humans | infotainment isn't the most intuitive offering in this class.
verdict: The BMW 8-series is the ideal grand tourer with powerful engine options, a sophisticated interior, and a top that drops for wind-in-the-hair cruising.

title: 2026 BMW X5 M
pros: Pavement-scorching acceleration | shocking athleticism for its size | posh and techy cabin.
cons: Punishingly hard ride | high cost of fee | the BMW M5 Touring station wagon is an even more tempting practical performance machine.
verdict: Don't let the BMW X5 M's sizable proportions fool you; it is a super SUV that delivers sports-car-rivaling performance.

title: 2026 BMW i5
pros: Acceleration that satisfies | comfortable and stylish interior | rewarding BMW driving behavior.
cons: EV componentry eats some trunk space | competitors offer more range at this price point | infotainment operation is borderline complex.
verdict: Essentially a BMW 5-series that just happens to have an electric powertrain, the i5 delivers all the trademark features BMW is known for.

title: 2026 BMW M5 Touring
pros: Prodigious speed and cornering grip | impressive cargo capacity | only slightly more expensive than the M5 sedan.
cons: Heavier than the already portly sedan | overwhelming number of settings and drive modes | light and numb steering.
verdict: With the same powerful 717-hp powertrain as the M5 sedan, the M5 Touring station wagon delivers performance and practicality in equal amounts.

title: 2026 BMW 2-Series
pros: Strong engines | lively handling | very quick in M240i form.
cons: Tiny back seat | limited steering feel | automatic transmission only.
verdict: The small and nimble 2026 BMW 2-Series coupe punches above its weight.

title: 2026 BMW 4-Series
pros: Eager and satisfying inline-six | impressive fuel efficiency | tasteful and traditional BMW interior appointments.
cons: Manual transmission is MIA | 3-series sibling offers more rear seat room | chassis lacks the instinctive responses of the best BMWs.
verdict: The 2026 4-series coupe brings style and sportiness, but buyers seeking the genuine BMW experience may be better served by its raucous M4 sibling.

title: 2026 BMW X7
pros: Remarkably agile for a large SUV | comfortable and richly appointed passenger compartment | trio of polished and powerful engine choices.
cons: Lilliputian third row | scant cargo space behind the last row | infotainment has a learning curve.
verdict: The 2026 BMW X7 SUV has superstar moves and abundant luxury but is short on third-row space and cargo room.

title: 2026 BMW M5
pros: Warp-drive acceleration | beautifully balanced handling | decent all-electric range for a 717-hp behemoth.
cons: Overwhelming number of settings and drive modes | steering lacks feel | 1000-pound weight gain from the previous generation.
verdict: The BMW M5 is the biggest and heaviest that it's ever been, but a 717-hp plug-in hybrid powertrain and balanced chassis keep it a pillar of the luxury sports sedan segment.

title: 2026 BMW 8-Series Gran Coupe
pros: Formidable styling | two great turbocharged engine choices | well-sorted chassis.
cons: Tight rear seats | light on steering feel and feedback | V-8's price jump is significant.
verdict: The 2026 BMW 8-series Gran Coupe blends style and speed in a luxurious manner rarely seen these days.

title: 2026 BMW X6
pros: Silky-smooth powertrains | splendidly finished cabin | drives as confidently as it looks.
cons: More expensive than the mechanically identical X5 | less cargo room than X5 | you pay thousands extra for its sleeker bod.
verdict: If the traditionally shaped X5 SUV is a little too zestless for your liking, the sloped-roof BMW X6 is a more style-conscious alternative.

title: 2026 BMW XM
pros: Monstrously powerful | indulgent interior | respectable EV range.
cons: Porky styling | complicated powertrain foibles | ride too stiff to be luxurious but not refined enough to be truly sporty.
verdict: The BMW XM is quick and ultra-indulgent, but conflicts between its sport and luxury sides lead to some discombobulation.

title: 2026 Toyota 4Runner
pros: All-terrain capability | more refined on-road than before | modern infotainment tech.
cons: Most-capable models require the hybrid powertrain | gas engine could use a bit more power | available third row is too snug for adults.
verdict: Whether you're a road tripper or a trail crawler, the 2026 Toyota 4Runner is down for your next adventure.

title: 2026 Toyota Mirai
pros: High-end looks | lively handling | generous driving range per fill-up.
cons: Big price tag | sleepy acceleration | trapped on the West Coast thanks to the limited hydrogen-refueling infrastructure.
verdict: The Toyota Mirai is a handsome and capable hydrogen-electric sedan, but the limited hydrogen infrastructure keeps it region-locked to the West Coast.

title: 2026 Toyota Tundra Hybrid
pros: High-output hybrid powertrain | comfortable ride | easy-to-use controls.
cons: Can't tow or haul as much as some competitors | hybrid system adds power but does little for fuel economy | entry trim starts expensive.
verdict: The 2026 Toyota Tundra Hybrid pickup provides ample power in a package with lots of space and plenty of safety features.

title: 2026 Toyota Land Cruiser
pros: Good power from the hybrid four-cylinder | retains true four-wheel drive with low range | smaller footprint pays dividends on tight trails.
cons: Interior pieces in the 1958 trim seem cheap | no longer available with a third row | real-world highway economy doesn't match the rating.
verdict: The 2026 Toyota Land Cruiser SUV is smaller and more efficient than its predecessor but can still hold its own off-road.

title: 2026 Toyota Crown Signia
pros: Lexus-like interior | plush ride quality | thrifty hybrid powertrain.
cons: Noisy engine under acceleration | bland handling | underperformed its EPA highway fuel economy rating in real-world testing.
verdict: If you want a Lexus on a Toyota budget, take a look at the 2026 Crown Signia, which deftly blends luxury and affordability.

title: 2026 Toyota Corolla
pros: Quite fuel efficient | plenty of standard driver-assist tech | available in sedan and hatchback form factors.
cons: Powertrains are a little unrefined | bland handling | hatchback cargo space isn't as generous as the sedan.
verdict: The 2026 Corolla sedan and hatchback are longstanding pillars of affordable transportation, but we prefer rivals that are more fun to drive.

title: 2026 Toyota Sienna Hybrid
pros: Most fuel-efficient minivan on offer | available all-wheel drive | couch-like comfort in all three rows.
cons: Grumbly engine note disturbs the peace | non-removable second-row seats | iffy styling.
verdict: With lounge-like seating for up to eight and a thrifty hybrid powertrain, the Toyota Sienna is a fuel-efficient living room on wheels.

title: 2026 Toyota Sequoia
pros: Standard hybrid powertrain balances output and efficiency | impressive towing numbers | for-real off-road gear offered by TRD.
cons: Cramped third row | short on cargo room with all seats in place | feels big from behind the wheel.
verdict: The 2026 Toyota Sequoia SUV offers good space in the first two rows but can't quite match the utility of other full-size SUVs.

title: 2026 Toyota bZ
pros: AWD models are quick | competitive range figures | faster charging.
cons: Bland exterior styling | unexciting handling | awkward seating position.
verdict: The 2026 Toyota bZ drops two characters from its previous name but gains range, faster charging capabilities, and new styling.

title: 2026 Toyota Corolla Cross
pros: A Corolla writ large | affordable pricing | comprehensive standard safety features.
cons: Indifferent powertrain | thinks performance is a dirty word | is fun’s biggest enemy.
verdict: What the 2026 Toyota Corolla Cross lacks in excitement, it more than makes up for with value-packed efficiency and utility.

title: 2026 Toyota Tundra
pros: Civilized ride thanks to coil-spring suspension | handsome looks | lots of available trim levels.
cons: Real-world fuel economy disappoints | competitors can tow more | some interior plastics feel bargain-bin.
verdict: The 2026 Toyota Tundra pickup truck blends comfort, style, and capability in the 'Yota mold, but its ultimate brawn quotient falls short of the competition.

title: 2026 Toyota Highlander Hybrid
pros: Good on gas | packed with features | spacious for first- and second-row passengers.
cons: Bland driving demeanor | tight third row | the larger Grand Highlander does the job better.
verdict: The 2026 Toyota Highlander Hybrid SUV is a well-equipped, extremely fuel-efficient option for families who might need to carry anywhere from three to eight.

title: 2026 Toyota Highlander
pros: Comfy interior | long standard-features list | rides smoothly.
cons: Kids-only third row | unremarkable driving experience | more expensive than the larger Grand Highlander.
verdict: The 2026 Toyota Highlander SUV is a reasonable value for families needing van-like space—a straightforward, restrained, tool for the job.
